title: 第25章 急训 下第26章 杂役小聚
slug: 修仙我觉醒了美食系统
content_zh:
林江月不仅冲破了幻觉屏障，还刺破了无寐识海中的防御。
“让我看看你识海里的阵。”
神识远荡，透过光幕来到一处市井。
市井景观如她历经心魔时一模一样。
“想必这就是你记忆深处的事物。”
林江月闻到包子、馒头香，精神一震，转而感叹无寐识海深处的真实。
“经过这条街，左拐就是‘程府’。”
林江月自说自话间再次看到那个牌匾。
此时的程府目光所及皆是喜色。
檐角下，两串硕大的红灯笼在风里微打转，门楣、廊柱上的红联是喜结连理贺词。
院中甬道铺了红花，两侧回廊下，每隔三步便悬一盏略小的琉璃红灯，人潮涌动、锦衣华服的宾客闲坐攀谈，皆是一片喜庆。
空气中浮着菜香、酒气在满载欢庆的人群中传递笑语。
就在此刻，天空忽然炸响惊雷。
林江月周围的人群四散逃离，无数双惊慌失措的眼睛从她眼前掠过。
“快跑！有妖怪！”
“救命——”
一个穿着血红长衣，手拿双刀，面色狰狞的男人砍过一人胸脯直冲林江月而来。
林江月拿出铁棍，上去就是一下。
？？
怎么扑了个空？

这一下没有打到那狰狞脸男，林江月的身影反而从他的身躯穿了过去。
狰狞脸男毫不理会林江月，径直走向程府。
程府之中刀剑声不断。
天空中飞下数个持剑青衣修士。
“归元剑宗前来驰援，尔等勿怕！”
院墙之上，修士剑光符箓纵横，鬼修黑雾锁链翻飞。
纯阳剑罡与阴煞鬼火不断碰撞湮灭。
风卷骨尘，战况惨烈。
忽地一道阴煞之气破空而下。
一个身穿黑袍，头戴高帽，面容枯槁，褶皱黝黑的老者从天而降，抓住一名身穿锦袍男人掐住喉咙。
“程府中的分身佛像放在何处？说出来饶你不死。”
只见那男子紧握老者手臂，手中燃起蓝火。
“你也是修士！？哼，不过是炼气期三层。”
这时一只小兽从那男子袖中飞出，咬断老者手臂，那男子挣脱，慌忙向前奔跑。
“去哪？”
只见那握住男子的断手上竟长出一张老脸。
content_en:
Lin Jiangyue not only broke through the illusion barrier, but also penetrated the defense in the sea of ​​​​Wumei consciousness.
"Let me see the formation in your sea of consciousness."
His consciousness wandered far away, and he came to a market through the light curtain.
The cityscape is exactly the same as when she experienced her inner demons.
"Presumably this is something deep in your memory."
Lin Jiangyue smelled the aroma of steamed buns and steamed buns, and was shocked. She then sighed at the truth deep in the sea of ​​Wumei.
"After passing this street, turn left and you will find 'Cheng Mansion'."
Lin Jiangyue saw the plaque again while talking to herself.
At this time, everyone in Cheng Mansion's eyes was filled with joy.
Under the eaves, two strings of huge red lanterns were swirling slightly in the wind. The red couplets on the lintels and pillars were congratulatory messages for the wedding.
The corridor in the courtyard was paved with red flowers, and a slightly smaller glazed red lamp was hung every three steps under the corridors on both sides. There was a huge crowd of people, and guests in rich clothes sat and chatted, all in a festive atmosphere.
The aroma of vegetables and wine floated in the air, spreading laughter among the celebrating crowd.
At this moment, thunder suddenly exploded in the sky.
The crowd around Lin Jiangyue fled in all directions, and countless pairs of panicked eyes passed before her eyes.
"Run! There's a monster!"
"Help——"
A man wearing a long blood-red coat, holding two knives in his hands, with a ferocious expression slashed through a man's chest and headed towards Lin Jiangyue.
Lin Jiangyue took out the iron rod and pushed it up.
? ?
Why did it come to nothing?
This time, the ferocious-faced man was not hit, but Lin Jiangyue's figure passed through his body.
The ferocious-faced man ignored Lin Jiangyue and walked straight to Cheng's house.
There was constant sound of swords in Cheng Mansion.
Several monks in green clothes flying down from the sky holding swords.
"Guiyuan Sword Sect is here to help, don't be afraid!"
On the courtyard wall, the monks' swords and talismans were criss-crossing, and the ghost cultivator's black mist chains were flying.
The pure yang sword and the yin evil ghost fire continue to collide and annihilate.
The wind swept away the bones and dust, and the battle was tragic.
Suddenly, a sinister aura broke through the air and descended.
An old man wearing a black robe and a tall hat, with a haggard face and dark wrinkles, fell from the sky, grabbed a man in a brocade robe and choked him.
"Where is the cloned Buddha statue in Cheng's mansion? Tell me and I will spare your life."
I saw the man holding the old man's arm tightly, blue fire burning in his hand.
"Are you a monk too!? Humph, you are only at the third level of Qi refining stage."
At this time, a small beast flew out of the man's sleeve and bit off the old man's arm. The man broke free and ran forward in a hurry.
"Where to go?"
I saw an old face growing out of the severed hand holding the man.
